spans.s:
विविदिवस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has known or
obtained or found.
विविदिवस् विविदिवस्, विविद्वस्. See p. 919.

विविद्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has known,
knowing, wise; one who has obtained.

विवक्वस् विवक्वस्, वान्, m. (fr. rt. वच्, q. v.),
Ved. one who repeats (praises), praising, a praiser,
(Sāy. = स्तुतीनां वक्तृ.)

विवक्षा विवक्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. वच्), a
wish or desire to speak; meaning, sense; intention, pur-
pose, wish, desire; a question.
—विवक्षा-वशात्, ind.
according to the meaning (of a speaker or writer).

विवक्षण, अस्, &c., Ved. (fr. rt. वच् or rt. 1.
वह्), ‘making eloquent,’ or according to Sāy. ‘bring-
ing to heaven’ (= स्वर्ग-प्रापण-शील), an epithet
of Soma.

विवक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desiring to mention,
wishing or intending to speak.

विवक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing or desiring
to speak about.

विवक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, wished or intended to be
spoken or said; purposed, intended; meant, signified,
really meant, literal (not figurative); wished, desired;
favourite, handsome; (अम्), n. what is intended to be
said or declared, meaning, sense, purpose, intention,
any desired object or aim; (आ), f. meaning, purpose,
wish (?).
—विवक्षित-त्व, अम्, n. the being intended
or meant to be said.

विवक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to speak, intending
to say.

विवच् वि-वच् (see rt. वच्), cl. 2. P. -वक्ति (in
the non-conjugational tenses also A.), -वक्तुम्, to de-
clare, announce, explain, interpret, solve; to dispute
about, speak against, oppose in argument; to speak va-
riously or differently, to dispute with one another (A.).

वि-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. of various speech, having
various speeches, variously praising, (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda

. वि-वाचः = विविध-स्तुति-
रूपा वाचो येषाम्, whose words have the form of
many kinds of praise); (क्), f., Ved. various speech or
[]
praise; N. of a particular sacrifice in which various
prayers and praises are repeated; dispute, controversy,
contention, strife (= सङ्ग्राम, Naigh.
II. 17

वि-वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who declares or ex-
plains, &c.

वि-वाक, अस्, m. one who decides causes, a judge;
[cf. प्रश्न-व्˚, प्राड्-व्˚.]
विवाक वि-वाक, वि-वाच्. See under वि-वच्.

विवञ्चिषु विवञ्चिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. वञ्च्), wishing to deceive; crafty, deceitful.

विवत्सा वि-वत्सा, f. a calfless cow, one
whose calf is dead.

विवद् वि-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -व-
दितुम्, to dispute, oppose in argument, contradict,
controvert, litigate, dispute about, discuss about (with
loc. of the thing disputed about); to dispute with or
engage in a discussion with any one (acc.); to cry out:
Caus. -वादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dispute or liti-
gate, commence an action or lawsuit: Intens. -वाव-
दीति, &c., to roar aloud.

वि-वदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wrangling, disputing, argu-
ing, contending, debating, contradicting; litigating.

वि-वदित, अस्, आ, अम्, disputed, controverted, liti-
gated.

वि-वाद, अस्, m. a dispute, quarrel, controversy,
debate, contest, strife, contention; an argument;
contest at law, legal dispute, litigation, lawsuit; crying
out, sound.
—विवाद-कल्पतरु, उस्, m., N. of a
work.
—विवाद-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a compen-
dium of civil law by an author named Misarū-miśra.
—विवाद-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m., N. of a work by Vā-
caspati-miśra.
—विवाद-भङ्गार्णव (˚ग-अर्˚),
अस्, m., N. of a compendium of civil law by Jagan-
nātha (compiled at the close of the eighteenth cen-
tury).
—विवाद-शमन, अम्, n. the allaying or
settling of a dispute, pacification.
—विवाद-सं-
वाद-भू, ऊस्, f. a matter or subject of controversy
and discussion.
—विवादानुगत (˚द-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, ‘gone through a lawsuit,’ disputed, litigated.
—विवादार्थिन् (˚द-अर्˚), ई, इनी, इ, seeking for a
dispute; (ई), m. a litigant, prosecutor, plaintiff.
—वि-
वादास्पदी-भूत (˚द-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, become the
subject of a lawsuit, litigated, contested at law.

विवादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, disputing, contending, litigating,
disputatious, contentious; a litigant, party in a lawsuit.
वि-वावदत्, अत्, अती, अत्, Ved. roaring aloud.

विवध् वि-वध् (a defective verb, see rt.
वध्), Ved. to destroy utterly.

विवध वि-वध, अस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 1.
वह् with वि), a yoke for carrying burdens, a load;
a road, highway; storing grain, hay, &c.; a ewer,
pitcher; [cf. वी-वध.]

वीवध वी-वध, अस्, m. = वि-वध, a yoke
or pole for carrying burdens; a burden; storing or
heaping corn; a road.

विवधिक, अस्, m. a man who carries a burden;
a dealer, peddler, hawker; [cf. वीवधिक.]

वीवधिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a man or woman who car-
ries a load by means of a yoke; a general dealer.

विवन्दिषु विवन्दिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid.
of rt. वन्द्), intending to praise; wishing to salute.

विवप् वि-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्-
तुम्, to strew or scatter about.
विवर वि-वर, &c. See under वि-वृ.

वि-वर, अस्, m. expansion, opening, widening,
separation; (अम्), n. a fissure, hole, chasm, cave,
cavern, burrow, hollow, vacuity; a sequestered or
solitary place; interval, intermediate space, space; a
breach, fault, flaw, defect, vulnerable place, weak
point, wound; a symbolical expression for the number
nine, (see रन्ध्र.)
—विवर-नालिका, f. a pipe,
fife, flute.
—विवरे-सद्, त्, त्, त्, abiding in inter-
mediate space, an inhabitant of the sky.

वि-वार, अस्, m. dilatation, expansion; open or
expanded state of the organs of speech, expansion of
the throat in articulation, (one of the Ābhyantara-
prayatnas or efforts of articulate utterance which take
place within the mouth, opposed to सं-वार.)
विवर्जन वि-वर्जन, &c. See under वि-वृज्.

वि-वर्जन, अम्, n. the act of excluding, abandon-
ing, leaving, shunning.

विवर्ण वि-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, colourless, want-
ing colour, changing colour, pale, wan, pallid; bad-
coloured, discoloured; low, vile; unlettered, ignorant,
stupid; (अस्), m. a man of low caste or of degrading
occupation, an outcast.
—विवर्ण-मणी-कृत, अस्,
आ, अम्, (a bracelet &c.) which has its jewels ren-
dered discoloured.
—विवर्ण-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्,
pale-faced.
विवर्त वि-वर्त, &c. See under वि-वृत्.

वि-वर्त, अस्, m. turning round, revolving, revolu-
tion, going or whirling round; dancing; rolling
onwards; unrolling, rolling back, returning, rolling
about, moving hither and thither, changing from one
state to another, passing through various existences
or states of being; modification, altered condition;
human error (consisting in the mistaking unreal
objects and conceiving them to be what they are
not, as mirage for water, a rope for a snake, &c.);
the unreal (as opposed to Brahma the only real
essence); collection, assemblage, heap, multitude.
—विवर्त-वाद, अस्, m. maintaining or asserting
that Brahma or the one eternal essence manifests
himself in various illusory forms.

विवर्ध् वि-वर्ध्, cl. 10. P. -वर्धयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cut off, sever.

1. वि-वर्धन, अम्, n. (for 2. see वि-वृध्), the
act of cutting off, cutting, dividing.

2. वि-वर्धन, अम्, n. (for 1. see वि-वर्ध्),
the act of increasing, augmenting, increase, growth,
augmentation, amplification, aggrandizement; (अस्, आ
or ई, अम्), growing, increasing, advancing, furthering.

1. वि-वर्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see वि-वृध्),
cut off, cut, divided.
विवर्षत् वि-वर्षत्. See under वि-वृष्.
वि-वर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, deluging with rain.

विवल् वि-वल्, cl. 1. P. A. -वलति, -ते, -व-
लितुम्, to turn away, avert.
वि-वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned away, averted.

विवल्ग् वि-वल्ग्, cl. 1. P. -वल्गति, &c., to
leap, jump, spring; to burst asunder.

विवश वि-वश, अस्, आ, अम्, unrestrained, un-
subdued, uncontrolled; independant; subject, sub-
jected; apprehensive of death; desirous of death (as
having the soul free from worldly cares and fears).

1. वि-वास, अस्, m. banishment, expulsion.
—विवास-
करण, अम्, n. causing banishment, banishment,
transporting.

2. वि-वास, अस्, आ, अम्, or वि-वासस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
without clothes, naked.

विवाश विवाश, आस्, m. pl., N. of a mythical
caste in Plaksha-dvīpa (corresponding to the Vaiśyas).

विवस् 1. वि-वस् (see rts. 3. वस्, 2. उष्, 2. व्य्-
उष्), cl. 6. P. -उच्छति, &c., Ved. to shine forth,
shine, dawn: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
shine.

विवस् 2. वि-वस्, cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to
exchange clothes; to wear, put on (a garment), clothe:
Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to clothe, put on, cover:
Pass. of Caus. -वास्यते, to be clothed or clad in.

विवस् 3. वि-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्,
to change an abode, to depart, go off, retire, with-
draw; to dwell, abide; to pass, spend (time &c.);
to pass away: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
dwell apart, banish, expel, drive into exile, transport,
dismiss.

विवस्वत्, आन्, m. ‘the brilliant one,’ N. of the
Sun, (sometimes regarded as one of the eight Ādityas
or sons of Aditi, his father being Kaśyapa; elsewhere
he is said to be a son of Dākṣāyaṇī and Kaśyapa;
in epic poetry he is held to be the father of Manu
Vaivasvata [or according to another legend of Manu
Sāvarṇi by Sa-varṇā], and therefore a kind of parent
of the human race [see Manu]; in Ṛg-veda

. he is described as the father of Yama Vaivasvata,
and in Ṛg-veda

. as father of the Aśvins by
Saraṇyū, and elsewhere as father of both Yama and
Yamī; according to Nīla-kaṇṭha, the name विवस्वत्
is derived fr. 2. वि-वस्, in the sense विशेषेण आच्छा-
दयति); N. of Aruṇa (charioteer of the Sun); of
the seventh or present Manu, (more properly called
Vaivasvata, as son of Vivasvat); a god; N. of the
author of the hymn Ṛg-veda

(having the
patronymic Āditya); N. of the author of a Dharma-
śāstra; (अती), f., N. of the city of the Sun.

विवस्वन्, आ, &c., Ved. shining, possessing bright-
ness; (Sāy. also ‘possessing wealth;’ in Ṛg-veda
. विवस्वभिः = ऋत्विग्भिः.)

1. वि-वासन, अम्, n. manifestation, (Sāy. = प्र-
काशन.)

2. वि-वासन, अम्, n. the act of banishing, banish-
ment, exile.

विवसन वि-वसन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of
garments, unclothed, naked; (अस्), m. a Jaina ascetic.

वि-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, banished, expelled, forced
into exile, transported.
वि-वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or exiled.

वि-वास्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being banished, being
exiled.

वि-वस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of clothing, unclothed,
naked.

विवह् वि-वह्, cl. 1. P. -वहति, -वोढुम्, to
bear away, remove, carry off, lead away; to conduct
home, take in marriage, marry: Caus. -वाहयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to marry, give in marriage; to marry.

वि-वह, अस्, m. ‘carrying away,’ epithet of one
of the seven tongues of fire.
वि-वह; add — N. of one of the seven winds.

वि-वाह, अस्, m. the taking a wife, marriage, (eight
kinds of marriage are enumerated in Manu
III. 21

,
viz. Brāhma, Daiva, Ārṣa, Prājāpatya, Āsura, Gān-
dharva, Rākṣasa, and Paiśāca; see also Yājñavalkya
[]

— 61.)
—विवाह-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of
marriage.
—विवाह-चतुष्टय, अम्, n. a quadru-
ple marriage, the marrying four wives.
—विवाह-
तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a part of the Smṛti-tattva.
—विवाह-दीक्षा, f. the marriage rite, marriage
ceremony.
—विवाह-दीक्षा-तिलक, अस्, अम्, m. n.
a Tilaka made on the forehead for a matrimonial cere-
mony.
—विवाह-दीक्षा-विधि, इस्, m. the preparatory
rites of matrimony.
—विवाह-यज्ञ, अस्, m. a matri-
monial sacrifice.
—विवाह-विधि, इस्, m. the law of
marriage.
—विवाह-वृन्दा-वन, N. of an astro-
logical work by Keśavārka.
—विवाहार्थ (˚ह-अर्˚),
अस्, m. purpose of marriage, a marriage suit.
—विवा-
हेच्छु (˚ह-इच्˚), उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of marriage.
वि-वाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to marry, married.

विवाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, taking a wife, marrying; re-
lating to marriage; [cf. अ-विवाहिन्.]

वि-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be married, marriageable;
(अस्), m. a son-in-law; a bridegroom.

वि-वोढृ, ढा, m. one who takes in marriage, a
bridegroom, husband.
विवोढृ वि-वोढृ. See under वि-वह्.

विवा वि-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to blow on
all sides, blow in every direction, blow, blow through.

वि-वात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, blowing on all sides,
blowing, blowing gently.
वि-वायमन, अस्, आ, अम्, blowing.

विविंशति वि-विंशति, इस्, m., N. of one of
Dhṛtarāṣṭra's sons.

विविक्वस् विविक्वस्, आन्, m. (fr. rt. विच्), Ved.
one who possesses discrimination, discriminating; an
epithet of Indra (in Ṛg-veda

विविक्ष् विविक्ष्, विविक्षत्, &c. See under
rt. 1. विश्, p. 941, col. 2.

विविक्ष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or ड्, ड्, ड् (fr. the Desid.), one
who wishes to enter, (see Vopa-deva
III. 151

विविग्न वि-विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, very agitated
or alarmed, terrified; very angry.

विविच् वि-विच्, cl. 7. 3. P. A. -विनक्ति,
-विङ्क्ते, -वेवेक्ति, -वेविक्ते, -वेक्तुम्, to separate or
divide asunder, rend or tear asunder; to distinguish,
discriminate, decide, judge between (two sides of a
question); to alter; to tear up, remove: Caus. -वेच-
यति, -यितुम्, to separate, distinguish, discriminate.

वि-विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated, disjoined, detached,
kept apart, scattered, abstracted, sequestered; single,
alone, lonely, solitary, private, deserted; distinguished,
discriminated, judged; discriminative, judicious; pro-
found (as judgment or thought); pure, faultless;
intent on; (अम्), n. separation, loneliness, privacy,
abstraction; a solitary place.
—विविक्त-तर्क, अस्,
आ, अम्, clear in reasoning.
—विविक्त-ता, f. the
being separated, separation, loneliness, privacy; an
empty or free space.
—विविक्त-भाव, अस्, आ, अम्,
having a mind separated or abstracted (from other
pursuits), intent on any object.
—विविक्त-वर्ण, अस्,
आ, अम्, having letters or syllables distinctly enunciated.
—विविक्त-सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeking solitude, solitary,
retired, recluse.
—विविक्तासन (˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a secluded seat, sitting in a sequestered place.

वि-विचि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. separating, discriminating,
a discriminator, (Sāy. = विवेचक); (इस्), m. ‘the
separator,’ epithet of Agni.

वि-विच्य, ind. having discriminated or judged,
having discussed or considered; having properly dis-
criminated; dividing or discriminating in regular
order; severally, one by one.

वि-वेक, अस्, m. discrimination, judgment, the
faculty of distinguishing and classifying things ac-
cording to their real properties; (in the Vedānta
system) the power of separating the invisible Spirit
from the visible world, (or spirit from matter, truth
from untruth, reality from mere semblance or illu-
sion); true knowledge; discretion; discussion, in-
vestigation; a receptacle for water, reservoir, basin
[]
(= जल-द्रोणी).
—विवेक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced
or arising from discrimination.
—विवेक-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, skilled in discrimination, intelligent.
—विवेक-
ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge arising from discrimina-
tion, faculty of discrimination.
—विवेक-ता, f. or
विवेक-त्व, अम्, n. judgment, discrimination, the
faculty of judgment.
—विवेकदृश्व-ता, f. or विवेक-
दृश्व-त्व, अम्, n. the character of a discerning man,
discrimination, discernment.
—विवेक-दृश्वन्, आ,
m. one who sees or is conversant with true know-
ledge, a wise or discerning man.
—विवेक-पदवी,
f. ‘path of discrimination,’ reflection.
—विवेक-विलास,
अस्, m., N. of a work.
—विवेक-सार, N. of a general
Vedānta disquisition in sixteen sections by Rāmendra-
yati.
—विवेक-सिन्धु, N. of an elementary treatise
on the Vedānta by Mukunda-rāja.

विवेकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, discriminating, discriminative,
judicious, prudent, discreet; (ई), m. a judge, dis-
criminator, sage, philosopher.
—विवेकि-ता, f. or वि-
वेकि-त्व, अम्, n. discriminativeness, discrimination,
discussion.

वि-वेक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distinguished or
discriminated, to be discussed or judged.

वि-वेक्तृ, ता, m. one who judges, a judge, decider
(of questions or causes), sage, wise man.

वि-वेचन, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of discrimination,
discriminating or distinguishing (as truth from false-
hood, reality from semblance), the making a distinc-
tion; investigation, judgment, decision.

वि-वेचनीय or वि-वेच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be distin-
guished or judged, to be discussed, distinguishable.

वि-वेचित, अस्, आ, अम्, discriminated, distinguished,
investigated.

विविध वि-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of various sorts
or kinds, divers, manifold, sundry, various, multiform;
(अम्), n. variety of action or gesture.
—विविध-
रूप-धृत्, त्, त्, त्, having various forms.
—विविधा-
गम (˚ध-आग्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, comprising various
sacred (or traditional) works.
—विविधोपल-भू-
षित (˚ध-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, decorated with various
jewels.
वीविध वीविध for वि-विध, q. v.
विविशिवस् विविशिवस्, विविश्वस्. See p. 941.

विविशिवस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, one who has entered,
(see Pāṇ.

विवीत वि-वीत, अस्, m. an inclosed spot of
ground (abounding in grass, wood, &c.), a preserved
or inclosed pasture ground, paddock.
—विवीत-भर्तृ,
ता, m. the owner of a preserved or inclosed pasture.

विवृ वि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते,
वृणाति, -वृणीते (in the Veda the form व्य्-अवर्
frequently becomes व्य्-आवर् or व्य्-आवः), -वरितुम्,
-वरीतुम्, to uncover, spread out, open, unfold, dis-
play, discover, reveal, make clear, illuminate, make
manifest, proclaim, publish, explain, describe, com-
ment upon; to cover over, cover up, stop up; to
obtain (Ved., according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
. विवव्रुः = व्यवृण्वन् = अलभन्त).

वि-वरण, अम्, n. the act of uncovering, spreading
out, expanding, opening, unfolding, displaying, ex-
posing, laying bare or open; explanation, exposition,
interpretation, gloss, comment, translation; detailing,
describing, description, specification, detailed account;
a sentence.

विवरिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to make manifest
or display; wishing to explain or declare.

वि-वृण्वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, making manifest, explain-
ing, declaring.

वि-वृण्वान, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovering, explaining,
publishing, &c.

वि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovered, unconcealed, (अ-वि-
वृत, hidden, concealed), unclosed, opened, open
(as the organs of speech for articulation); bare, barren
(as ground, earth, &c.); spread out, expanded, ex-
tended, extensive, ample, spacious, large; displayed,
unfolded, exposed, discovered, made manifest, evi-
dent; published, divulged, proclaimed, explained,
interpreted, expounded; (अम्), ind. openly, in the
sight of every one; (आ), f. a particular disease, an
ulcer attended with much pain and heat; (अम्), n.
(in grammar) open articulation, approach of the tongue
towards the organ of speech but without contact.
—विवृत-पौरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose prowess
is displayed, displaying valour.
—विवृत-स्मयन,
अम्, n. an open smile, a smile by which the teeth
are shown.
—विवृताक्ष (˚त-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, open-
eyed, large-eyed; (अस्), m. a cock.
—विवृतास्य
(˚त-आस्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, open-mouthed.

वि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or twisted round,
whirling, revolving, rolling.

वीवृत वीवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-वृत, revealed,
published.
विवृतवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has opened.

वि-वृति, इस्, f. expansion, making clear, manifesta-
tion; display; exposure, discovery; explanation, ex-
position, gloss, comment, interpretation.
—विवृति-
विमर्शिनी, f., N. of a work by Abhinava-gupta.

वि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. turning round, revolution, rolling,
whirling, tumbling; (in grammar) interval between
two vowels, hiatus.
—विवृत्ति-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्,
preceded by a hiatus.
—विवृत्त्य्-अभिप्राय, अस्, m.
an intended or apparent hiatus.

वि-वृत्य, ind. having uncovered, having opened,
having expanded, displaying wide.
विवृक्ण वि-वृक्ण. See under वि-व्रश्च्.

वि-वृक्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. entirely severed or
cut asunder, cut off, (Sāy. = विशेषतश् छिन्न.)

विवृज् वि-वृज्, Caus. or cl. 10. P. A. -वर्ज-
यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to exclude; to avoid, shun, abandon,
leave; to distribute, give: Pass. of Caus. -वर्ज्यते,
to be avoided.

वि-वर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded, to be
abandoned, to be shunned or avoided, to be quitted.

वि-वर्जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, avoiding, shunning,
leaving.

वि-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, left, abandoned; avoided
by, shunned by (with inst. or at the end of a comp.);
destitute of, deprived of, entirely free or exempt
from, without, (मान-विवर्जितम्, ind. without
honour, dishonourably); excepting, excluding; dis-
tributed, given.
वि-वर्ज्य, ind. having avoided, having abandoned.

वि-वृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned, left; (आ), f. a
woman disliked or deserted by her husband (= दुर्-
भगा).

विवृण् वि-वृण्, cl. 6. P. -वृणति, &c., or
Caus., to exhilarate.

विवृत् वि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते (rarely P.
-वर्तति), -वर्तितुम्, to turn round, roll round, re-
volve, whirl round; to roll onwards, become unrolled;
to roll over; to turn or roll about, roll or turn hither
and thither, move about, wind about; to move
through; to roll or turn away from, depart from,
turn back, return; to roll down, descend; to attack:
Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to turn round or
revolve, cause to alternate.

वि-वर्तन, अम्, n. (in some senses fr. the Caus.),
turning round, revolving, revolution (as of a wheel
&c.), whirling or going round, circumambulating
[]
(an altar &c.); reverential salutation; rolling back,
returning; rolling down, descending; passing through
a change or succession of various states or existences;
existing, being, abiding, continuing; tossing to and
fro; causing to revolve or go round; whirling round;
causing to change, overturning.

वि-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back or round,
revolving, rolling onwards, turning back, declining,
setting (as the sun), returning, recoiling; continuing
or abiding (in any course of action).

वि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, revolved,
rolled or rolling about; whirled round; turned or
moved about, moving hither and thither; unrolled,
unfolded; returned, turned back or away, averted,
turned the wrong way, distorted, bent, bent down.

वि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, turning round, revolving;
turning back.
विवृत्सत् विवृत्सत्. See under rt. 1. वृत्.

विवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), wishing
to be or exist.

विवृध् वि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -वर्-
धितुम्, to grow up, increase, swell, become en-
larged, become powerful; to prosper, thrive; to
spring up, arise; to have reason to rejoice or be
congratulated: Caus. -वर्धयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to grow or increase, enlarge, augment, magnify,
amplify; to cause to prosper, advance, further; to
elevate; to gratify, exhilarate.

वि-वर्धत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, increasing, growing
bigger, thriving, &c.

वि-वर्धमान, अस्, आ, अम्, growing up, increas-
ing, thriving.

वि-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, grown up, increased, en-
larged, enhanced, augmented, intensified; large,
abundant.
—विवृद्ध-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, whose
anger or resentment is increased.

वि-वृद्धि, इस्, f. growth, increase, great growth,
augmentation, enlargement; prosperity.

विवृष् वि-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्षि-
तुम्, to rain down, rain: Caus. -वर्षयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to rain, rain down upon.

विवृह् वि-वृह् (see rt. 1. वृह्), cl. 6. P. -वृहति,
-वर्हितुम्, Ved. to rend asunder, tear to pieces, break
up, split; to tear away, draw away, tear out, remove.
वि-वृढ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. torn asunder, rent.

विवृहत् विवृहत्, अन्, m., N. of the author
of the hymn Ṛg-veda

(having the patro-
nymic Kāśyapa).

विवे वि-वे, cl. 1. P. A. -वयति, -ते, &c.,
Ved. to interweave.

विवेन् वि-वेन्, cl. 1. P. A. -वेनति, -ते, &c., to
be hostile or ill-disposed, (in Ṛg-veda

. मा
वि-वेनतम् = मा वि-कामौ भवतम्, [O Aśvins]
be not ill-disposed.)

विवेल्ल् वि-वेल्ल्, cl. 1. P. -वेल्लति, &c., to
struggle, tremble.

विव्रत वि-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perform-
ing various religious actions or ceremonies; many-
actioned (said of horses; Sāy. = विविध-कर्मन्).

विव्रश्च् वि-व्रश्च्, cl. 6. P. -वृश्चति, &c.,
[]
Ved. to cut off, cut asunder, separate, sever; to
destroy; to be cut asunder, cut off, (Sāy. on Ṛg-
veda
= विच्छिद्यते.)

वि-वृश्चत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. cutting
asunder, separating, scattering.

विव्वोक विव्वोक, अस्, m. (etymology doubt-
ful), affectation of indifference, (one of the ten forms
of amorous dalliance practised by women to excite
love; cf. वि-कृत.)
विविक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to enter.
विविक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to enter.

विविश्वस्, आन्, उषी, अत्, = विविशिवस् above; [cf.
also विविश्वस् under rt. विछ्.]
विवृत्सितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who wishes to be.

विवर्षिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid. of rt. वृष्),
inclined or disposed to rain, about to rain.

विवारयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus. of rt.
वृ), wishing to keep back, desirous of restraining.

विवित्सा, f. (fr. the Desid. of rt. 1. विद्), the wish
to know or understand, desire of knowledge.

विवित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to know, desiring
knowledge.
